Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First of all, you could, like, make an attempt to go to the west. And then, take the paper towel from the table. If you have got the paper towel, make an effort to move east. Following that, make sure that the formless chest in the pantry is ajar. And then, place the paper towel inside the formless chest within the pantry. And once you've done that, you win!
